claims.claim: Infleqtion reported achieving 30 entangled logical qubits on Sqale on 2026-09-24, satisfying the previously forward 2026 roadmap milestone and reducing one technical-timing uncertainty, but this does not by itself establish economic quantum advantage, customer workload superiority, or scalable unit economics.

The company's 2026 Form 10-K identifies remaining commercialization bottlenecks including scaling qubit count/fidelity, reducing component cost, scaling logical-to-physical qubits, and developing validated high-volume manufacturing processes; these remain relevant successor risks after the 30-logical-qubit milestone.

The earlier Q2 reporting correction and operating-loss/cash-burn evidence remain relevant to Alpha's downside treatment; the new logical-qubit milestone changes technical execution evidence but does not resolve financing, customer concentration, gross-margin, or economic-utility questions.

risks.risk: Technical milestone completion does not yet demonstrate commercially valuable quantum advantage or customer economics.
High-volume manufacturing process and partner validation remain disclosed scale-up dependencies.
Operating losses and prior cash-burn evidence remain relevant until Alpha establishes durable economics from current primary financial sources.

contradictions.contradiction: The prior Beta unknown that the 30-logical-qubit 2026 milestone remained unverified is now stale as a timing/execution unknown because the issuer reported achievement on 2026-09-24; independent verification and economic utility remain open.
contradictions.disposition: narrow the old unknown rather than treat it as a present blocker

unknowns.unknown: Independent third-party verification of the 30-logical-qubit result and workload-level economic advantage remain open.
Customer concentration, normalized gross margins and post-working-capital cash burn remain Alpha-owned underwriting gaps.

assistOutcome: new primary-source evidence narrows a prior technical execution unknown and supplies Alpha with source-addressed downside/falsifier context without assigning a numeric risk score
